notes.title: Adventure Update now availlable
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684297/0deb55f8790f83c46690b0fcb43d2729daa68f50.png

The a1.1.0 update brings many changes and improvements to the game, along with the addition of the first main quest, "A New Adventure," serving as a tutorial.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684297/4a94bbac48c8af229d46c401a1b7634aa6356c68.png

Here is the list of new features in this version:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684297/33bdb13de5a6d704bcfe4e947997b17327ad21e5.png

- New interface, optimized and simplified.

- Fixed numerous issues related to options.

- Corrections in French and English languages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684297/f1248ec25f0ce8780d372fe9c7c76b2d5eee5490.png

- Fatigue and Energy System: The character loses energy over time or while running.

- It is possible to sleep at home to pass the night or day (outside of the tutorial).

- Inventory available (concept).

- Teleportation altars are available (outside of the tutorial).

- Boat navigation and fishing systems are available (under certain conditions).

- Added "Free Exploration" mode to access the universe without quest restrictions.

- Fixed many issues and general improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684297/f725a7b46e75f38f6685c08391e7e283449d0efb.png

- Added the first main mission, "A New Adventure."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684297/8193bbdedaabc81aa579fc2ad5358132c049b73b.png

IMPORTANT: The greyed-out phrases with the "impossible" mention will be activated later and will allow modifying the mission's progression based on the answers provided.

Please also note that the game is far from being finished, and many improvements will be rolled out in the coming months.

The development team at Oricia Games Albi.

notes.title: Release date of the next update for Fisherman's Island !
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that the release date for the next big update of Fisherman’s Island will be officially revealed on November 29, 2024! 


This special date marks the 1st anniversary of our Steam launch, and we couldn’t think of a better way to celebrate this milestone with you. Stay tuned for more surprises as we approach this exciting day! 


Thank you for your incredible support and for being part of this journey. Let’s set sail together into the future of Fisherman’s Island!

notes.title: Fisherman's Island, Major Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684297/df34ab2ada9e99ce7c123c673c56037995f31942.png

Hello everyone!

The next update of Fisherman's Island is about to arrive. We are in the testing and debugging phase, so we still have a few weeks to go!

Our last message was in February, where we detailed the new sprint and fatigue mechanics. These mechanics are still in place, but the user interfaces have been updated since then.

Please refer to this post to learn more about these mechanics!

Please note that the 2024 roadmap is no longer valid and is completely outdated, as the development goals and especially the publication schedules have changed. The 2025 roadmap will be much more realistic in terms of updates.

The release of the next update will also mark the beginning of a new era for the development of Fisherman's Island: more updates, but of smaller sizes.

This means that starting with the release of version a1.1.0, we will continue to develop large updates, but smaller updates will be released to improve the game from time to time!

We will keep you informed in the coming weeks (in 1 week? 2 weeks?) when the tests for update a1.1.0 are finished. We will provide the full patch notes via a post on Steam as well as on our social media!

Thank you for your support and see you soon!

Oricia Games
Albi, London, and Lédergues.

We continue to arrange the space to make it more and more accessible!

Note

notes.title: Release of version a1.0.0 on Steam
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=8oV6YwBE44o;full][/previewyoutube]


Fisherman's Island is now available on Steam!

We eagerly await your feedback!

It's the big day! Version a1.0.0 (first alpha version) of Fisherman's Island is now available on Steam! You will find the basics of exploring the game. Feel free to give us as much feedback as possible on the overall game to make it better and better!

Attention!

The game is currently in early Alpha, which means that the game's quality and content are not representative of the final product's quality. About 5% of the final project is currently available!

Update Note


Nothing to report; the Alpha version is considered a new game!


Next Planned Content


Navigation at sea with your boat
New missions to advance the story
New places to explore
Quick travel system across the island
Improvement of the sound environment
Correction of reported bugs (feel free to let us know!)


Update a1.0.0 of November 29, 2023
